Young adult novel · Superhero · 2021

Cavaleiro da TerraO Primeiro Verão

Written and illustrated by J.D. Andrade · Editora Inverso

A boy and his best friend in an unusual situation. A small, quiet town with a secret. A villain so powerful he's almost ridiculous. A love interest. A traumatic event from the past. An incomplete family… and a gripping adventure from start to finish. There's nothing more to say. It's a superhero story.

Romance · Second chance · 2026

Maldito Destinoco-written with Thomas Martins

Written and illustrated by J.D. Andrade · Editora Flyve

  • nostalgia
  • writer × lawyer
  • haters to lovers

Thomas had already buried his great love story when his book, Maldito Destino, became a bestseller. The happy ending he wrote for Jonas and Giulia stirred up feelings that seemed long asleep. Was the plot an idealized version of his life with Sofia Melo, his greatest love? Back in his hometown, nostalgia and a night of drinking with his father lead him to confess everything in a letter. The only problem? She's about to get married.

About

Hi, I'm Jotadê.

João Daniel Andrade Bezerra, from Londrina, Brazil. Professional graphic designer and illustrator for 6 years, and a published author. I work on commercial projects, personal commissions and freelance gigs, and spend the rest of my time inventing worlds: elemental heroes, flying ships, post-apocalyptic worlds and, every now and then, a romance or two.

I wrote and illustrated Cavaleiro da Terra: o Primeiro Verão and wrote Maldito Destino, my two published books; the first was nominated for the 2022 Jabuti Prize for Literature. Every piece in this portfolio is drawn by hand, with no AI.
